description: This file implements the PollingProxyConfigService class, which manages proxy configuration updates via polling, including thread-safe operations, observer notifications, and asynchronous configuration retrieval.

classes.name: PollingProxyConfigService::Core
classes.description: A reference-counted internal class that handles polling, configuration retrieval, and observer notification in a thread-safe manner.

methods.name: PollingProxyConfigService::AddObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer to be notified of proxy configuration changes.

methods.name: PollingProxyConfigService::GetLatestProxyConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the latest proxy configuration if available.

methods.name: PollingProxyConfigService::OnLazyPoll
methods.description: Triggers a poll if enough time has elapsed since the last poll.

methods.name: PollingProxyConfigService::UsesPolling
methods.description: Indicates that this service uses polling for configuration updates.

methods.name: PollingProxyConfigService::PollingProxyConfigService
methods.description: Constructor initializing the polling interval, config fetch function, and traffic annotation.

methods.name: PollingProxyConfigService::~PollingProxyConfigService
methods.description: Destructor that marks the core as orphaned.
